propositions: Four overlay and leaf criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7900 agentic runs due to insufficient trigger vocabulary

A deterministic pre-filter gate must fire only when criterion-specific vocabulary is present in plan text, file_impact paths, or file_impact reasons, then route fired plans unchanged through the existing LLM router

The gate implements conjunction (T13/T14/removal-rationale/asserted-capability text_all regexes must all match), disjunction over globs and reason-regex arms, and file_impact matching without a deleted-file schema flag

Every criterion skip must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with rule name, visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, with duplicate skip recording prevented by gating at the assemble step only

The four audit-derived trigger regexes (T13 enforcement vocabulary, T14 scheduler/release/workflow vocabulary, removal-rationale deletion vocabulary, asserted-capability module-ref and capability-verb conjunction) must fire on all recorded evasion sentences and preserve fire/no-fire behavior for existing T5a/T5d/T7/T12 rules
